verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec file, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. Related assets exist: a GraphQL API with a schema, llms.txt documentation indexes, an interactive API Explorer, and an MCP server with type-discovery tools. None of these is documented as a downloadable machine-readable API spec, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: with a schema covering orders, catalog, customers, inventory, and other Square objects
